_comment: Pinned versions of the tools the app bundles and drives (M-Flasher, m-bootloader, SLOOP 3). Every file: upstream release tag + commit, URL, size, SHA-256, licence. 'verified' says how the SHA-256 was checked against upstream when the pin was made. M-Flasher's binaries are not in git: tools/fetch_tools.py downloads them at build time and checks them against these values; the m-bootloader and SLOOP 3 files are in fm1companion/tools/bundled. Change only with tools/update_tool_pins.py and a review.

m-flasher.title: M-Flasher
m-flasher.help_source: sha256 of USAGE + newline in src/cli.rs at the tagged commit (what `m-flasher --help` prints)
m-flasher.write_verified_note: Writes only ever run a binary whose SHA-256 is listed here for its version and architecture (reviewed in an app release); a downloaded copy of a listed version with other bytes is never used for writing.
m-flasher.verified_note: Measured on the files downloaded over HTTPS from the release (no SHA256SUMS upstream; GitHub's per-asset digest could not be read when pinning). The aarch64 binary is byte-identical to the one in the release's m-flasher_0.12.1-1_arm64.deb. tools/update_tool_pins.py --check compares these values with GitHub's digest.

m-bootloader.title: m-bootloader
m-bootloader.verified_note: fm1-uboot.boot matches its line in the release's SHA256SUMS and is byte-identical to data/bootloader-fm1.boot inside M-Flasher 0.12.1 (tag commit 8fbece7).

sloop3.title: SLOOP 3
sloop3.verified_note: The release file is byte-identical to the AREA inlined in index.html at the tagged commit and in the release's installer-sloop3-3.4.0.html. Corresponding source: the tarball of isod89/sloop3-fm1 at the same commit, already attached to every app release for the bundled SLOOP 3 editor.
